clues.text: When the Jerusalem disciples chose seven men to wait on tables, this man full of faith was named first.
Full of grace and power, this early believer in Jerusalem performed great wonders and signs among the people.
Men from the Synagogue of the Freedmen argued with him but could not stand up to his wisdom.
As he faced the Sanhedrin on false charges, its members saw his face was like the face of an angel.
Before the enraged Sanhedrin, he looked into heaven and saw Jesus standing at the right hand of God.
As he was stoned outside the city, witnesses laid their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.
While being stoned, he fell to his knees and cried, "Lord, do not hold this sin against them."
